## Reproduce

Keep MCPJAM_API_URL and MCPJAM_API_KEY set to this isolated account.

\`\`\`sh

npm run eval
\`\`\`

The script validates the versioned suite against project_fixture, runs it to completion,
and writes artifacts/eval-report.json. A completed passing run exits 0; a measured evaluation failure exits 1. Each invocation st
arts a new run. If a launch response is lost, use its recorded idempotency key from artifacts/run.stderr to retry that launch rath

er than starting another.

## Evidence

- artifacts/doctor.json: Streamable HTTP connection ready; arithmetic-fixture 1.0.0 ex

.\n- .mcpjam/evals/arithmetic.json: direct tool call followed by toolResultContains requiring the full text fragment {"sum": 5}. T
his is a text-content assertion, not structural equality.\n- artifacts/eval-report.json: latest completed passing run, ${run.runs[
0].id}.\n- artifacts/negative-report.json: wrong-answer control requiring {"sum": 999} failed, with CLI exit 1.\n- artifacts/itera
tions.json: initial run'"'"'s recorded tool arguments and result.\n\nThe isolated service labels these runs SIMULATED: determinist
ic fixture execution; no hosted model or live billing. This checks the authored tool case and assertion path; it does not establis

h LLM tool-selection accuracy or full MCP protocol conformance.

## Setup concerns resolved

Cloud servers are listed through
mcpjam cloud projects servers, rather than cloud servers. Schema version 2 requires mode agentWorkflow and a model field even for
this direct tool case. The platform refused toolResultMatchesSchema as outside its supported subset; toolResultContains succeeded.
The local runner documentation says direct toolCall steps and gating tool-result assertions require the hosted runner, so this wo

rkflow uses cloud eval run.
